content: This seems a bit long for a clash. Just reading the question takes a few minutes. Great puzzle, but I'm not sure it's great as a clash (<5min).
Thanks for the feedback @Compootah! You're probably right, but I'll wait for a few more reviewers to chime in first before reworking this clash :)
No problem! I hope this works out though. This looks really fun

I recently read https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement and the first thing on "Guidelines to write good statements" made me remember this contribution: "Keep it clear and concise; A long statement can scare players away".
And being honest, it really made me close this page and leave it for others to read :/ . I guess I was not the only one. If I was playing a clash, I would surely get jumpscared by the goal section :( .
Btw, I didn't vote this contribution. I would never leave a down/upvote on a contribution that I didn't properly tested. :)
